text: Let the Lone Wolf show his strength. Room for the leader of the Pack! Spring, Akela!” The Lone Wolf must have sprung and missed his hold, for Mowgli heard the snap of his teeth and then a yelp as the Sambhur knocked him over with his forefoot. He did not wait for anything more, but dashed on; and the yells grew fainter behind him as he ran into the croplands where the villagers lived. “Bagheera spoke truth,” he panted, as he nestled down in some cattle fodder by the window of a hut.
